none: PAS CAM-B84979: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I, AD 306-337
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS ; D/ CONSTANTI-NVS [MAX AVG]

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I, AD 306-337 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers and one standard. Mint is uncertain, AD 335-337. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTI-NVS [MAX AVG]. Obverse shows Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue reads: / //[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.91g, diameter is 16.2mm,…
